title: Sushi, Salads, BBQ, and Cheese Boards: Pregnancy Food Safety Analysis
excerpt: Analyzing the safety of international dishes for pregnant women, including sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards.
content:
## Introduction
When it comes to pregnancy, choosing safe and nutritious food is crucial. However, with the variety of international dishes available, many pregnant women are often unsure about what to eat and what to avoid. In this article, we will analyze the safety of sushi, salads, BBQ, and cheese boards for pregnant women.

## Food Safety Analysis
According to the CDC and NHS, pregnant women should avoid eating the following foods:
* Uncooked or unpasteurized sushi and sashimi
* Unwashed and unpasteurized salads
* Undercooked BBQ
* Unpasteurized soft cheese

However, if these dishes are cooked or pasteurized properly, they can be a part of a healthy diet for pregnant women.

## Nutrient Combination
To ensure adequate nutrition, pregnant women should combine the following foods:
* Cooked or pasteurized sushi and sashimi with vegetables and fruits
* Washed and pasteurized salads with protein sources like chicken, fish, and eggs
* Cooked BBQ with vegetables and fruits
* Pasteurized soft cheese with whole grain bread and fruits

## Foods to Avoid
According to the FDA and EPA, pregnant women should avoid eating the following foods:
* High-mercury fish like shark, swordfish, and king mackerel
* Undercooked eggs
* Undercooked meat
* Unpasteurized milk

## Practical Tips
To ensure food safety for pregnant women, follow these tips:
* Always wash your hands before preparing and eating food
* Always check the label and expiration date of food
* Always cook food properly and pasteurize when necessary
* Always avoid eating uncooked or unpasteurized food

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about food safety during pregnancy, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. You can also check out our [meal planner](/planner) for a healthy and safe diet.

* NHS: Foods to avoid in pregnancy — https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/keeping-well/foods-to-avoid/
* FDA: Food Safety for Pregnant Women — https://www.fda.gov/food/food-safety-pregnant-women

## FAQs
* Q: Is it safe to eat sushi during pregnancy?
A: No, it is not safe to eat uncooked or unpasteurized sushi during pregnancy.
* Q: How can I ensure food safety during pregnancy?
A: Always wash your hands, check the label and expiration date, cook food properly, and pasteurize when necessary.
* Q: Should I avoid all types of cheese during pregnancy?
A: No, you do not need to avoid all types of cheese, but you should avoid eating unpasteurized soft cheese.
